|This low, her gaze escaped.
Prepare, sisters. Weave hope anew.

<b>Rune Harps</b> are [[Items_(Silksong)#Tradables|tradable items]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. Strung with silk runes inscribed by the Weavers, they can be deciphered after being sold to [[Relic Seeker Scrounge]].

== Use ==
Can be sold to [[Relic Seeker Scrounge]] for {{R|210}}.

After sale, they can be read by visiting Relic Seeker Scrounge, or in the [[Bellhome]] after purchasing the [[Desk]].

<i>Words of a Weaver from the nest beneath Bone Bottom.<br><br>
"Hide her deep, the despised child, our shame shown in shell of iron. She is a wish cast vain, divinity mimicked in form too frail."</i>
|-
! [[File:Rune Harp.png|72x72px|center|link=Rune Harp|Rune Harp]] Rune Harp
| 
<i>Plea of a Weaver from the furthest edge of Pharloom.<br><br>
"Flee, sisters. Flee until your strength exhausts, so far you may escape at last her silken sight.<br><br>
To start anew, to sustain, free of web and service eternal."</i>
|-
! [[File:Rune Harp.png|72x72px|center|link=Rune Harp|Rune Harp]] Rune Harp

<i>Last words of the Weavers.<br><br>
"Sisters, spiders, the burden is passed. These simple bugs shall bear it full. Never to cease. Never to silence.<br><br>

There are a total of three Rune Harps that can be obtained.
